_meta.what: Observed annual mean PM2.5 by monitoring station, 2024, beside the satellite annual mean of the nearest district.
_meta.source: India Air Quality Database, XKDR Forum (https://airquality.xkdr.org), CC BY 4.0
_meta.source_networks: CPCB Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring network; US Department of State monitors via AirNow
_meta.compared_with: SatPM2.5 V6GL03 (ACAG/WashU) 2024 annual mean, per district
_meta.completeness_rule: all 12 months, each with at least 75% of possible hours
_meta.annual_mean: mean of the twelve monthly means, not hour-weighted
_meta.join: nearest district centroid, capped at 50 km
_meta.caveat: A station is a point and the satellite value is a district mean, so the observed figure sits above it by construction. Read this as agreement in pattern, not as either number correcting the other. Readings are published by XKDR as received, with no gap filling or outlier removal, and the source networks label them preliminary.
